main.description: Declares which questions asked on a document the author accepted or hid. Lives in the document's repo, with a record key matching the document's. An answered question shows unless hidden; any other question is pending.

subject.description: The document whose questions this record moderates.

accepted.description: pub.leaflet.interactions.question records shown on the document.

hidden.description: pub.leaflet.interactions.question records never shown on the document.
